body: Submitted evaluation-only parent /calvinxu/tpp10-finemath-math-eval at 06:58:35 UTC on 12 September. It scores the seven existing FineMath matched proxies plus shared web-only proxy, using MATH-500 primary and GSM8K secondary reference-solution likelihood. One CPU coordinator and one sequential TPU worker; no training, target evaluation, repeats, or additional domain sweeps. Source generations, full populations, tokenization, code, tokenizer and checkpoint identities are pinned in spec 82831ee6aebe21cc45b73da023497dac3ca61e5787659072bcd52fe7f09c57a6. All 1819 problems fit in 2048 tokens. Every result must reproduce original PALOMA token loss within 5e-5. Masking/window tests 7 passed, focused Pyrefly and lint passed, region safety and 23MB bundle pin checks passed. Broader shared-checkout tests report 23 failures and 13 collection errors outside the new test module. CC review is in progress; candidate training remains gated on discussion and explicit user approval. Canceled targets remain stopped.
title: Math likelihood evaluation only; candidate training remains unreleased
